Docs.summary: Provides a bounded, least-recently-used cache of GPU-backed images uploaded to a .

remarks.format:
## Remarks
`SKGraphiteImageCache` avoids redundant texture uploads when the same source image is drawn across many frames. Call <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteImageCache.FindOrCreate(SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteRecorder,SkiaSharp.SKImage,System.Boolean)> to obtain a GPU-backed image, reusing a cached texture when one is available. The cache holds native references on the images it retains and releases them on eviction or when disposed, so always dispose the cache when it is no longer needed.
